# Data Model for Knowledge Compiler

This module implements a comprehensive data model for the knowledge compiler, enabling the representation of various entities, relationships, and compile runs within the knowledge base. Each class corresponds to a table in the database, facilitating organized storage and retrieval of information related to repositories and their associated compile information.
